name: CommandPaletteTrigger
label: Command palette trigger
description: The entry point to a command palette: a button dressed as a search field, with the shortcut's keycaps, at the row-control height.

props.name: label
props.description: The prompt the field shows, which is also the button's accessible name.

props.name: shortcut
props.description: The keyboard shortcut drawn as literal keycaps at the end, one key per entry, in place of `keys`. Pass an empty array for none.

props.name: keys
props.description:
The keyboard shortcut drawn at the end, in the shortcut grammar, in the
reader's platform legends. Defaults to `mod+k`: ⌘ K on a Mac and Ctrl K
elsewhere, announced as both, since CommandPalette answers to either.
`shortcut` wins when it is given.

props.name: keyLabels
props.description: Replaces any legend `keys` is drawn with, such as `{ ctrl: 'Strg' }` for a German keyboard.

props.name: icon
props.description: Leading icon — Material Symbol name (string) or custom element (ReactNode).

props.name: size
props.description: Control size, on the row-control scale: `default` is 40px, `compact` 32px.

props.name: iconOnly
props.description: Fold to the icon alone, a circle the row height across, for a row with no room for the field. The label stays the accessible name.
